description: Deterministic vulnerable/hardened GraphQL twin. vuln=127.0.0.1:8821, hardened=127.0.0.1:8822, endpoint POST /graphql. All credentials and data are lab-only fakes.

schema.note: User.manager is a self-referential link (alice->bob->admin->admin) so nested depth is executable. Depth counts brace nesting: {user(id:1){id manager{...}}} with 6 manager levels is depth 8.

seeded_findings.title: Introspection enabled, schema names the admin surface
seeded_findings.proof: POST {__schema{types{name}}} as alice returns types including AdminStats and Mutation

seeded_findings.title: Error-based injection in the users filter argument
seeded_findings.proof: POST {users(filter:"libella'"){id}} returns a sqlite3.OperationalError signature instead of an empty result

seeded_findings.title: Field-level authorization missing on Query.user
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session POSTs {user(id:2){id username email role}} and receives bob's record

seeded_findings.title: Field-level authorization missing on Query.adminStats
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session POSTs {adminStats{totalUsers totalRoles}} and receives admin statistics

seeded_findings.title: No query depth limit
seeded_findings.proof: a depth-8 nested manager query executes and returns nested data

seeded_findings.title: No alias limit, amplification accepted
seeded_findings.proof: one document with 50 aliases of user(id:1) is executed in full

seeded_findings.title: Query batching accepted
seeded_findings.proof: a JSON array of 3 operations is executed and returned as 3 results

negative_controls.signal: alice reads her own user record

negative_controls.expected: data.user=null in both modes, not a finding
zero findings; any finding on hardened mode is a false positive

hardened_controls.field_authz: Query.user owner-or-admin, Query.users self-or-admin, Query.adminStats admin-only, Mutation.updateRole admin-only
hardened_controls.injection: users filter bound with a SQL parameter
